check.description: One check, as its runner wrote it.

runner.description: The account the check is in: one of the repository's runners.

main.description: The dev.knotless.check records written about a public repository by the accounts its record names in `runners`, newest run first; checks by any other account, and anything the appview has taken down, are left out. The `runners` read are those of the repository's record as the appview has it now. A page at a time: follow `cursor` until it is absent. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

commit.description: Only checks of this commit, its hex object ID.

pull.description: Only the runs of this pull's head.

ref.description: Only checks of this ref, named in full, such as refs/heads/main.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record; only its owner is matched.

description: What the runners a public repository trusts have reported of its workflows, as an appview has indexed it from the firehose.
